insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 15 G3+ games, 33/75 picks (44%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 43 champs in G1s, 54 in G3+.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Sejuani is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Sejuani in 19/50 games (38%): 2 picks (0-2) and 17 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Kalista against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Kalista against them in 25/50 games (50%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Vi? They go Lee Sin
insights.text: Vi is a G1 favorite (7/21 G1s, played by Josedeodo). In the 19 later games where it was burned or banned, Josedeodo went to Lee Sin (3/19) and Wukong (2/19).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They get stronger as the series goes deep
